row:
Welcome to Forest Canine, a channel for passionate dog lovers, pet parents, and canine enthusiasts seeking advice, tips and valuable information on how to optimise their beloved four-legged friend’s overall physical wellness by preventing injury, reducing pain and promoting longevity!
 
My name is Jess. I am a Canine Massage Therapist and Dog Mum to Woody & Meeko. I believe every dog deserves to live a happy life free from injury, pain and unnecessary health issues. I am here to support you and your furry companion! You have the power to become your dog’s advocate by making simple, yet effective LIFESTYLE CHANGES. 

So come on lets start making small changes today! Your dog will thank you for it!

Disclaimer
The purpose of this channel is to educate and inform. It is not a substitute for veterinary care. You are encouraged to do your own research and should not rely on this information as professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
